newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 26.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on November 26:
WASHINGTON - Representatives of the computer, consumer electronics and television industries agreed not to seek an official national transmission standard for digital broadcasts.

PARIS - When USAir Group Inc said recently it would order as many as 400 passenger jets from the European consortium Airbus Industrie, the announcement poured fuel on an already burning rivalry between the world's top two commercial aircraft manufacturers.
WASHINGTON - After years of fighting the job-diminishing effects of computerised directory assistance, Bell Atlantic Corp operators got to revisit the old days as computers crashed.
NEW YORK - Blue chip shares soared, defying expectations of a Thanksgiving week slowdown, boosting the Dow Jones industrial average above 6500.
